instruction: Love is not a spiritual discipline (Sadhana); it is, in itself, the state of unitive consciousness (Samadhi). Faith (Shraddha) and devotion (Bhakti) are preparatory stages; Love is a transcendent state attained only by the most fortunate. Within this state, the lover and the beloved merge into a seamless unity, where the very categories of duality and non-duality are transcended. The discursive intellect dissolves, the mind vanishes—this is the state designated as 'Samadhi'.
